plainText:
In manga, an is a volume release collecting multiple volumes or arcs which were originally released separately. Manga publishers release omnibus collections typically of older works, combining them in a bargain format and often collecting a particular story arc, although some omnibus releases cover an entire manga series.

To date, the Pokémon Adventures manga has been released in omnibus format in several countries: in Japan, / / / , , , , , , and .

==Japan==
===2011 releases===
In 2011, a series of omnibus releases were announced in Japan, collecting the . The arc was chosen due to its high popularity in Japan. These volumes were issued under Shogakukan's "My First WIDE" brand.

While was released in March 2011, the other two planned volumes were cancelled and Volume 1 was quietly discontinued. This is believed to be due to the depictions of earthquakes and tsunami in the , which were deemed inappropriate following the . 

 

===2014 releases===
In 2014, Shogakukan announced that they would be releasing a new omnibus edition of the , in commemoration of the release of Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire. The volumes were released under Shogakukan's "My First BIG Special" brand, which are bargain-priced volumes sold only in Japanese convenience stores. A total of four volumes were released from October 24, 2014 to December 5, 2014.

Satoshi Yamamoto confirmed on his Twitter account that the new series of volumes has no connection to the 2011 releases and that the 2011 releases have been permanently discontinued. 

 

===2017 releases===
In 2017, it was announced that a new omnibus edition of the would be released under the title "Pocket Monsters Special Paperback Edition Red, Green & Blue Chapter". A total of two volumes were released, beginning with volume one on July 4. These volumes were later released in English in by Shogakukan Asia under the title "Pokémon Adventures RGB".

 

==United States/Canada/United Kingdom/Australia==
===Collector's Edition===
In July 2019, a series of omnibus volumes collecting the original first 29 volumes titled Pokémon Adventures Collector's Edition was announced by VIZ Media. A total of 10 volumes were released from April 14, 2020 to October 12, 2021.

 

===Deluxe Edition===
In May 2026, a series of hardcover omnibus volumes titled Pokémon Adventures Deluxe Edition was announced by VIZ Media. 

 

==Singapore==
===Red, Green & Blue arc===
In July 2018, a new series of omnibus volumes of the was announced by Shogakukan Asia, publishers of the Pokémon Adventures manga in . The volumes are based on the "Pocket Monsters Special Paperback Edition Red, Green & Blue Chapter" omnibus volumes released in Japan a year earlier. These releases use VIZ Media's translation.

 

===Ruby & Sapphire arc===
In January 2015, a new series of omnibus volumes was announced by Shogakukan Asia, publishers of the Pokémon Adventures manga in . The new omnibuses collect the , originally found in through , over a series of four volumes. These releases use VIZ Media's translation.

 

==France==
===Red, Green & Blue / Yellow arc===
On April 25, 2014, publisher Kurokawa announced they would start publishing the and arcs together in omnibus format. While both arcs had been previously released in France by publisher Glénat, these volumes feature a new translation. Kurokawa's omnibus volumes contain all the adventure route maps from the original Japanese volumes, but lack the character introduction pages from the beginning of those. A boxed set containing the three volumes was released on November 9, 2017. 

 

===Gold, Silver & Crystal arc===
On December 24, 2015, following the completion of the , Kurokawa announced they would start publishing the in omnibus format. A boxed set containing the three volumes was released on November 15, 2018. 

 

===Ruby & Sapphire arc===
On November 21, 2014, following the completion of the , Kurokawa announced they would start publishing the in omnibus format, tying in with the newly released . A boxed set containing the three volumes was released on October 10, 2019. 

 

===FireRed & LeafGreen / Emerald arcs===
On March 24, 2017, Kurokawa announced they would start publishing the and arcs together as a series of four omnibus volumes. A boxed set containing the four volumes was released on October 8, 2020. 

 

===Diamond & Pearl / Platinum arc===
On January 16, 2018, Kurokawa announced they would start publishing the and arcs together in omnibus format. A boxed set containing the five volumes was released on October 14, 2021. 

 

===HeartGold & SoulSilver arc===
On October 10, 2018, Kurokawa announced they would publish the as a single omnibus volume. 

 

===Black & White arc===
On April 13, 2023, Kurokawa announced they would start publishing the in omnibus format. The arc had been previously released in a more traditional format from 2011 to 2014.

 

===Black 2 & White 2 arc===
On October 28, 2020, Kurokawa announced they would start publishing the in omnibus format. 

 

===X & Y arc===
On October 13, 2025, Kurokawa announced they would start publishing the in omnibus format. Each volume comes with a bonus mini poster.

 

===Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire arc===
On September 7, 2023, Kurokawa teased a 2024 release for the . On August 1, 2024, the arc was officially announced to be published as a series of two omnibus volumes. Each volume comes with a bonus mini poster.

 

==Germany==
===Regular edition===
====Red, Green & Blue / Yellow arcs====
The and arcs were released together as three omnibus volumes by Panini Comics from February 25 to June 30, 2025.

 

====Gold, Silver & Crystal arc====
The arc was released as three omnibus volumes by Panini Comics from August 26 to December 16, 2025.

 

====Ruby & Sapphire arc====
The arc will be released as three omnibus volumes by Panini Comics from February to June 2026.

 

===Limited edition===
====Red, Green & Blue / Yellow arcs====
To coincide with the twenty-fifth anniversary celebration of the Pokémon franchise, publisher Panini Comics reissued the and arcs of the manga in one boxed set, consisting of three omnibus volumes, on August 31, 2021. Included with the books were seven postcards with the original Japanese cover illustrations of the seven adapted volumes. The release itself is limited to 2500 copies.

 

====Black & White arc====
On November 21, 2023, Panini released a limited-edition boxed set of the . It consists of three omnibus volumes and includes nine postcards with the original Japanese cover illustrations of the adapted volumes. The release itself is limited to 1111 copies.

 

====X & Y arc====
On October 25, 2022, Panini released a limited-edition boxed set of the . It consists of three omnibus volumes and includes six postcards with the original Japanese cover illustrations of the adapted mini-volumes. The release itself is limited to 2500 copies.

 

====Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon arc====
On March 22, 2022, Panini released a new limited-edition boxed set, this time for the . It consists of three omnibus volumes and includes six postcards with the original Japanese cover illustrations of the adapted mini-volumes. The release itself is limited to 2500 copies.

 

==Italy==
Following the completion of the in mini-volume format, started publishing the previous arcs in omnibus format through boxed sets.

===Red, Green & Blue / Yellow arcs===
The and arcs were released together in a boxed set of three omnibus volumes on November 16, 2016. Each volume was released separately at a later date.

 

===Gold, Silver & Crystal arc===
The was released in a boxed set of three omnibus volumes on November 15, 2017. Each volume was released separately at a later date.

 

===Ruby & Sapphire arc===
The was released in a boxed set of three omnibus volumes on October 24, 2018. Each volume was released separately at a later date.

 

===FireRed & LeafGreen / Emerald arcs===
The and arcs were released together in a boxed set of four omnibus volumes on June 5, 2019. Each volume was released separately at a later date.

 

===Diamond & Pearl arc===
The was released in a boxed set of four omnibus volumes on November 6, 2019. Each volume was released separately at a later date.

 

===Platinum / HeartGold & SoulSilver arcs===
The and arcs were released together in a boxed set of two omnibus volumes on October 28, 2020. Each volume was released separately at a later date.

 

===Black & White / Black 2 & White 2 arcs===
The and arcs were released together in a boxed set of four omnibus volumes on September 21, 2022. Each volume was released separately at a later date.

 

===X & Y arc===
The was released in a boxed set of three omnibus volumes on April 11, 2025. Each volume was released separately at a later date.

 

==Spain==
In October 2015, publisher announced they would be publishing the entirety of the Pokémon Adventures manga. Due to the length of the series (52 volumes at the time of announcing the license) and due to different story arcs often starting and ending partway through volumes, Norma Editorial opted for an omnibus format, with 30 volumes released. The volumes have double numbering to accommodate fans who may wish to begin reading from a particular story arc. For example, the was published over two volumes, which were numbered as Yellow volumes 1 and 2, and as volumes 3 and 4 of the series overall.

The first volume to be released was volume 1 on October 29, 2015. For their first releases, Norma Editorial alternated between the and arcs. The was eventually released in the same format as volumes 31 and 32.

 

==Vietnam==
===Red, Green & Blue arc===
On April 22, 2019, Vietnamese publisher released the as a series of two omnibus volumes. They are based on the "Pocket Monsters Special Paperback Edition Red, Green & Blue Chapter" omnibus volumes released in Japan in 2017.

 

==References==
